subject: general
question: A man travelled a distance of 47 km in 6 hours. He travelled partly on foot at the rate of 6(1)/(2) km/h, and partly on bicycle at the rate of 8(1)/(2) km/h. The distance travelled on foot is:
solution:
Given:

Total distance = 47 km

Total time taken = 6 hours

Speed on foot = 6(1)/(2) km/h i.e. 6.5 km

Speed on bicycle = 8(1)/(2) km/h i.e. 8.5 kmph

Concept used:

Distance = Time × Speed

Calculation:

Let the time he traveled on foot be Q hours.

Distance traveled by bicycle = (6 - Q) hours

According to the question,

6.5 × Q + 8.5 × (6 - Q) = 47

⇒ Q = 2

Hence, the distance traveled on foot = 6.5 × 2 = 13 km

**∴ The distance traveled on foot is 13 km.**
